cases.name: summary_matches_database
cases.expected_sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
    'total_loans',
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.loans),
    'by_status',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'status', s.status,
                    'count', s.loan_count,
                    'total_amount', s.total_amount
                )
                ORDER BY s.status
            )
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    status,
                    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
                    SUM(amount)::text AS total_amount
                FROM public.loans
                GROUP BY status
            ) s
        ),
        '[]'::json
    )
)
